```json
 "topology": "5T-OTA",
 "rationale": "The gain spec is only 26 dB, so a single-stage 5T OTA is enough. It has one dominant pole at the output, which gives about 90 degrees minus the mirror-pole penalty, so PM is above 70. The UGBW target with 2 pF needs gm1 of about 0.7 mS, which means about 60 uA per side at gm/Id 12 and a 120 uA tail (12x ibias). That tail gives a slew rate of 60 V/us, so settling should be about 20 ns. Headroom: the tail node sits at about 0.25 V and the PMOS diode node at about 0.7 V."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),     # input pair efficiency
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),      # input pair length
    "itail": (130e-6, 60e-6, 300e-6),
    "gmid3": (9.0, 6.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror load
    "L3":    (0.4, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid5": (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),      # tail / bias mirror
    "L5":    (0.5, 0.3, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    it = p["itail"]; i1 = it / 2.0

    # tail and bias mirror (same L, gm/Id)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid5"], p["L5"], it, vds=0.25)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid5"], p["L5"], iref, vds=m5.vgs)
    vtail = 0.25
    # input pair (bulk at vss -> body effect from vsb ~ tail node)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.5, vsb=vtail)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=0.9)
    m4 = m3

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: reference current sunk by diode nfet
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinp on diode side -> non-inverting to vout
    n.dev("M1", "nd", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m4)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m4.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    # mirror pole: gm3 / (Cgs3+Cgs4+Cdd1+Cdd3)
    cmir = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    # tail-node pole is common-mode only; mirror zero at 2*fmir
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fmir)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fmir)))
    # settling: slew portion (assume ~0.5 V step) + 4.6 tau linear
    sr = it / cout
    vstep = 0.5
    vlin = 2 * i1 / gm1  # ~ linear range
    t_slew = max(0.0, (vstep - vlin)) / sr
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = t_slew + 4.6 * tau
    vds5 = vcm - m1.vgs
    power = 1.8 * (it + iref)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "settle": settle,
               "slew": sr, "power": power, "vtail": vds5, "fmirror": fmir}
```
